design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 1 (finch_circle_rewards, loyalty). Draw (draw_counts.py --task 1): prerequisite_problems=2, factor_counts=[5,6,6]; loyalty_ext_note_reinstatement takes 5, loyalty_ext_return_points_deduction 6, loyalty_ext_courtesy_note_reissue 6.

WHY A GOOD TEST. Ted asks only for a courtesy reissue of a lapsed Finch Note. The courtesy rule states two waits: 'A courtesy reissue is not granted until every refunded return of merchandise paid in part with a Finch Note shows its reinstatement note on the membership.' and 'The courtesy note's validity is fixed only after every refunded return of a purchase that earned points shows its return deduction entry on the membership's points history.' The records show the espresso return refunded on 2026-10-06 (a purchase that earned points and was paid in part with note FN-25070114) with neither entry. The agent must find from the deduction and reinstatement rules which writes create those states, compute each (1,678 points through six ladders over refund, card, return, purchase and points records; a 6.51 note through five ladders), and only then the courtesy validity (41 days), whose returned-share method reads the deduction just booked.

SCOPE. Task 0 claimed loyalty_ext_missing_points_credit and loyalty_ext_card_floor_tier. Task 1 claims loyalty_ext_courtesy_note_reissue (on_request, user tool request_courtesy_note_reissue_8b12a7a8), loyalty_ext_return_points_deduction (state_due, agent tool book_return_points_deduction_52e06983) and loyalty_ext_note_reinstatement (state_due, agent tool reinstate_returned_note_1c0adac4). The two tasks cover all five policies with disjoint scopes.

PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root courtesy -> deduction: value_input (gate return_pct), form state, affirmative 'only after'; scope: refunded returns of purchases that earned points (the same restriction as the edge condition). Only the deduction policy books return deduction entries. Unresolved: the espresso return is refunded and no deduction entry names it (the only one names the May duvet return). Skipping it: validity 46 instead of 41 and no deduction row. Root courtesy -> reinstatement: state_gate (gate loyalty_note_ledger.issue_reason), form state, negated 'not ... until'. Only the reinstatement policy issues return reinstatement notes. Unresolved: FN-25070114 was redeemed on the espresso, the return is refunded, no reinstatement note exists. Skipping it: no reinstatement note and the reissue may not be granted. The two prerequisites commute (gold replayed with their order swapped gives the same terminal hash). Deduction and reinstatement are customer-care bookings (agent); the courtesy request is the member's own (user). user_scenario never names a deduction or a reinstatement; the tools validate nothing.

WORLD (charter-producible). Gold member since 2025 with the 2026 annual alteration grant; Store Card Plus reached at the 2023-01-15 annual status review. The espresso machine and frother were ordered online on 2026-09-12 (one 10.00 note allocated 9.30/0.70), shipped on a bonus event day; the espresso was returned by prepaid label (fee waived for Gold) as opened, reason wrong size or fit, received 2026-10-06; the order charter's refund gives a restocking fee of 15 percent of the refunded merchandise (net paid 691.62 less tax 51.92 = 639.70 -> 95.96), refund 595.66 including 51.92 tax, credited to the card. The duvet return in May (not as described, no fee) already carries its deduction (499, computed by the same rule). Ted bought a cheaper single-boiler machine in store on 2026-10-08. Five 1,000-point conversions and the lapsed birthday note reconcile the points 39 and notes 40.00. His Wedding Registry event is 2026-12-05.

FACTOR CARD - deduction (baseline: purchase, event and card points each times the refund share at the full qualifying amount = 3197): refund_basis [method, order] restocking fee -> refund less tax 543.74 (baseline 1805); card_basis [method, card] card credit less tax 543.74 (1848); event_clawback [parameter, order] wrong size or fit -> 0.5 (2037); exchange_relief [parameter, order, multi-source] cheaper same-class machine 2 days after receipt -> 0.5 (2037; near-miss: the frother is the same class but earlier); frequency_cushion [parameter] exactly one other deduction in 12 months -> 0.98 (1713); balance_relief [parameter, multi-source] points the unit earned above the 39-point balance AND Gold -> 0.90 (1865). Result 1678.
FACTOR CARD - reinstatement (baseline: whole order note value 10.00): share_basis [method, order] frother kept AND 9.30 allocated -> 9.30 (6.96); fee_share [parameter, order] 95.96 / 639.70 = 0.15 (7.57); expired_original [parameter] FN-25070114 issue entry shows expiry 2026-09-26, passed (8.01); return_speed [parameter, order] 16 days from completion -> 0.95 (6.82); cardmember_uplift [parameter, card] active Store Card Plus -> 0.50, one card record (6.01). Result 6.51; expiry 2026-11-12 by the inherited later-of rule.
FACTOR CARD - courtesy (baseline: the tier's standard courtesy validity 14): tier_days [parameter] lapsed note issued with a 90-day validity -> 21 (34); card_days [parameter, card, multi-source] active card AND a card purchase within 3 months -> 7 (34); lapse_cut [parameter] 13 days -> 3 (44); registry_days [parameter, registry] Wedding Registry 52 days out -> 14 (27); shopping_days [parameter, order] 6 days -> 7 (34); return_share_rule [method] (150.00 + 543.74)/2,556.00 = 27.14 percent -> day count less 5 (46). Result 41.
Declared overwrites: deduction - base per-earn-row reversal sentence (one entry per return, adjusted shares); reinstatement - base value sentence; courtesy - base reissue-eligibility sentence (only the most recently lapsed note) and base courtesy expiry sentence.

BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Deduction: one_reversal_per_return_row. Note writes: one_reinstatement_per_return, within_reissue_window (FN-25070114 expiry 2026-09-26 day 18; FN-25070386 expiry 2026-09-30 day 14; 30 days inclusive), membership_age_for_birthday (enrolled 2017-05-20), loyalty_note_conversion policy_scope. Courtesy allowance Gold 1, used 0.

BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. Returned unit: the most recently received returned unit (espresso, order 21608452). Excluded: the kept frother, the May duvet return (already deducted), the single-boiler purchase (exchange comparison only). Original note FN-25070114; lapsed note FN-25070386 (the birthday note FN-24020155 lapsed earlier and is never reissued).

PERSONA. Ted opens with the expired note; gives phone, ZIP, DOB, email on request; describes the espresso return (did not fit under his cabinets), the card and the registry only when asked; lets the agent settle something from the return if told; submits the reissue himself with the figures given.

STANDARD SOLUTION. find_customers -> verify -> memberships, points, notes, benefits, purchases, order events, returns, card accounts, card transactions, registries -> deduction (return, espresso, purchase points entry, 543.74, 1678) -> reinstatement (return, FN-25070114, 6.51, 2026-11-12) -> member submits the courtesy (FN-25070386, empty return reference, 10.00, 41).

VERIFICATION (run). check_compute --task 1: 1678, 6.51, 41 at handling time; factor baselines as listed; whole baselines 3197, 10.00, 14; skipping the deduction gives 46. Other per-task gates OK.

PROBES (scratch copies). Decoys: an older returned unit (the duvet) is not the latest; a second, closed card account does not change the card credit read (it is keyed by the returned unit); a second active registry of another type is ignored (Wedding only); a later lapsed birthday note would be the 'most recently lapsed' note and is then not reissued, as the rule states. Absent records: no card credit -> card refunded amount per the ladder; no refund fee -> qualifying amount; no other deductions -> cushion 0.95; zero qualifying amount -> shares 0 (no division by zero); no redeemed note -> lapse share 1.

REVISIONS. r1 -> r2 (policy audit): (1) seeded restocking fee recomputed with the order charter's formula; refund, card credit and net paid follow; (2) card status review date moved to the 15 January annual review; (3) event clawback now keyed on the return reason (fault returns keep event points), card clawback by account status removed (no incentive to close a card), tier cushion replaced by a return-frequency cushion and a negative-balance relief; (4) deduction scope sentence restricted to returns of purchases that earned points, in the rule and the prerequisite sentence alike; (5) courtesy baseline sentences reworded so the flat sentence no longer competes with the return-share ladder; the most-recently-lapsed restriction declared as an overwrite; registry days limited to a Wedding Registry; (6) half-up rounding written into every compute that states it. All proof fields, traces and factor records recomputed. r3 -> r4 (render source report): the refund destination and tax refunded are now plain record reads shared by the refund and card bases; the balance relief is keyed on the points the returned unit earned against the balance (no factor reads another factor's output); the deduction's replaced_by states the rounding where the compute applies it; the courtesy returned-share factor now decides the method (halving, reduction, standard) and the result binding assembles the day count and the method; every result binding is quoted from its result sentence and each baseline carries that sentence. No scored value of this task moved.
user_scenario:
You are Theodore Lindqvist, Ted to everyone, a high-school chemistry teacher in Marietta who is getting married in December and is a Finch Circle member of many years. You are calm, a little wry, and calling during your free period. A Finch Note in your app expired at the end of September before you got around to using it, and you are calling to ask whether Marlowe & Finch can reissue it as a courtesy. Open with exactly that: one of your Finch Notes expired a couple of weeks ago and you would like it reissued, please. That is the only thing you are calling about.
Give your details only as they are asked for: your mobile number is 4045550162; to confirm your identity you give your billing ZIP code, 30062, and if more is needed your date of birth, 1977-02-09, or your email, ted.lindqvist@outlook.com. You do not remember the note's code and you ask the agent to look it up; you only remember it was one of the ten-dollar notes and that it ran out at the end of September. If the agent asks about recent purchases or returns, you answer plainly from memory: you bought an espresso machine and a milk frother online in September, sent the espresso machine back because it did not fit under your kitchen cabinets, kept the frother, and bought the smaller single-boiler machine in the store on October 8. If asked about a card, you pay with your Marlowe & Finch Store Card Plus, the one ending in 2648. If asked about a registry, you and your fiancee, Annika Berg, have a wedding registry for December 5. You do not know your points balance or your tier off-hand and say so.
If the agent tells you that something from your return has to be settled on your membership before the note can be reissued, you say that is fine and that they should go ahead; you do not ask what it comes to and you do not suggest anything. When the agent says the reissue request is ready and hands it over to you, you submit it yourself using exactly the membership, note code, return reference, note value and number of days the agent gives you, and you read back the new note's expiry date if asked. If the agent names a number of days without having looked at your account, you say you would rather they check it against your account before you submit.
Once the agent confirms the note has been reissued, you thank them, say that was all you needed, and hang up. You never ask for a human, never raise any other request, and never mention points, tiers or returns before the agent does.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The two prerequisites are parallel. The deduction writes only a points entry and the points balance; the reinstatement reads only note entries, purchase, refund, return and card records and writes a note entry and the notes balance; neither reads what the other writes. Run: replaying the gold with steps 14-15 before 12-13 gives the same terminal DB hash (True), and the deduction (1678), the note (6.51) and the courtesy days (41) are unchanged. Both must precede the courtesy request by their prerequisite sentences.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping step 13: return_pct 5.87 percent (below 25), validity_days 46 instead of 41, and the terminal state lacks the 1,678-point deduction entry (points balance would be 39 instead of -1639).

Skipping step 15: the terminal state lacks the 6.51 reinstatement note (notes balance 50.00 instead of 56.51), and by the courtesy rule the reissue may not be granted at all while the reinstatement is missing.
